pack.cover_note:
Since March 2025 I have been building and running Albie, a 24/7 autonomous operator on the Anthropic Claude Agent SDK: WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack and Discord, Apollo and Zoho campaigns, proposals, coding, scheduled tasks, persistent memory. My own company runs on it daily. Blue Canvas AI sells, scopes, builds and operates production agent systems for six SME clients; The Wall Group's net profit rose 17% year on year from the workflows we integrated, funding their acquisition of a new site.

forgd's delivery model, embedding with customer engineering teams from Claude Code adoption through to agentic applications, MCP servers and evaluation frameworks, is the work I already do, including rubric-graded, mutation-tested eval environments designed for HUD.ai. Eighteen years of commercial and deep-tech leadership mean I scope and sell the engagement as well as build it.

Stack: Python, TypeScript, SQLite, REST APIs, browser automation. Based in Derry, remote, comfortable with 10–20% travel.
